00068 void SOSUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00069 {
00070     int filterLoops = UGen::getFilterLoops();
00071     int filterRemain = UGen::getFilterRemain();
00072     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00073     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00074     float* a0Samples = inputs[A0].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00075     float* a1Samples = inputs[A1].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00076     float* a2Samples = inputs[A2].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00077     float* b1Samples = inputs[B1].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00078     float* b2Samples = inputs[B2].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00079     float y0;
00080     
00081     while(filterLoops--)
00082     {
00083         y0 = *inputSamples++ + *b1Samples++ * y1 + *b2Samples++ * y2; 
00084         *outputSamples++ = *a0Samples++ * y0 + *a1Samples++ * y1 + *a2Samples++ * y2;
00085         
00086         y2 = *inputSamples++ + *b1Samples++ * y0 + *b2Samples++ * y1; 
00087         *outputSamples++ = *a0Samples++ * y2 + *a1Samples++ * y0 + *a2Samples++ * y1;
00088         
00089         y1 = *inputSamples++ + *b1Samples++ * y2 + *b2Samples++ * y0; 
00090         *outputSamples++ = *a0Samples++ * y1 + *a1Samples++ * y2 + *a2Samples++ * y0;
00091     }
00092     
00093     while(filterRemain--)
00094     {
00095         y0 = *inputSamples++ + *b1Samples++ * y1 + *b2Samples++ * y2; 
00096         *outputSamples++ = *a0Samples++ * y0 + *a1Samples++ * y1 + *a2Samples++ * y2;
00097 
00098         y2 = y1; 
00099         y1 = y0;
00100     }
00101     
00102     y1 = zap(y1);
00103     y2 = zap(y2);
00104 }
